problem.headline: Postmortems captured whatever the on-call engineer remembered to write
problem.detail: Format, depth and follow-through varied by author, so lessons from one incident rarely reached the team that hit the next similar one.

capability.headline: Every postmortem now follows the same structure and links its own history
capability.detail: The assistant drafts a structured timeline from the incident channel and surfaces prior postmortems with a similar signature.

outcome.headline: Institutional memory of incidents is now something the team can search

significance.headline: The team stops relearning the same lessons under pressure
significance.detail: New engineers can read the incident history for a system before they are paged for it, not after.

claims.statement: every postmortem now follows a common template with a searchable timeline and root-cause section
reviewers can trace a current incident to prior postmortems with a similar signature without manual search
